properties.name: gothdb.security.mode
properties.description: How access to the GothDB API and UI is authorized.

properties.name: gothdb.security.username
properties.description: User name accepted by HTTP Basic authentication. Used by the 'basic' mode only.

properties.name: gothdb.security.password
properties.description: Password accepted by HTTP Basic authentication. Used by the 'basic' mode only. When left empty a password is generated on every start and written to the log, which is meant for development only.

properties.name: gothdb.security.realm
properties.description: Realm sent in the WWW-Authenticate challenge. Used by the 'basic' mode only.

properties.name: gothdb.security.roles
properties.description: Roles allowed to reach GothDB. Used by the 'spring-security' mode only. An empty list accepts any authenticated user. Names without a ROLE_ prefix get one.

values.description: Use 'spring-security' when Spring Security is on the classpath, otherwise 'basic'.
Require HTTP Basic credentials configured under gothdb.security, independently of Spring Security.
Require an authenticated user from the application's own Spring Security configuration, optionally holding one of gothdb.security.roles.
Serve the API and UI without authentication. The full contents of the database become readable by anyone who can reach the path.
